$comment: Registry of every available MCP server. Profiles reference these keys. Fields: repo (git url), dir (clone dir name), runtime, entry (main script), entryDocker, build (npm build script, or null if no build), needsGui (display/device), needsDevice, docs, env (default env placeholders), description.

chaining-mcp-server.name: Chaining MCP
chaining-mcp-server.description: Intelligent tool orchestration, route optimization, sequential thinking and multi-server workflow management.

filesystem-mcp-server.name: Filesystem MCP
filesystem-mcp-server.description: Advanced file and directory operations, content reading, search, archive and file watching.

Project-Guardian-mcp-server.name: Project Guardian
Project-Guardian-mcp-server.description: Project memory and knowledge management: knowledge graphs, task tracking, SQLite operations.

terminal-mcp-server.name: Terminal MCP
terminal-mcp-server.description: System command execution with local/remote (SSH) support, sessions, timeouts and env control.

research-mcp-server.name: Researcher MCP
research-mcp-server.description: Combined research platform: Google Search + Wikipedia with analysis, fact-checking and research sessions.

browser-agent.name: Browser Agent
browser-agent.description: Playwright-based browser automation with 88 tools for navigation, scraping, form filling and screenshots.

scrcpy-mcp.name: scrcpy MCP
scrcpy-mcp.description: Android device control via ADB and scrcpy: screenshots, input, UI inspection and app control.

ll3m-agent.name: LL3M Agent (Blender)
ll3m-agent.description: Autonomous 3D modeling system for Blender with iterative refinement and multi-agent reasoning. Requires local Blender installation.

the-designer.name: The Designer
the-designer.description: UI/UX design system selector, token generation, brand cloning and component preview generation.
